content:
Create a Claude Project for your AI video workflow and put your niche, style, and target audience into the project instructions so outputs stay consistent  
Write a single master script prompt that specifies hook formula, tone, pacing, and target video length, then save it as a project file for reuse  
Paste your script into ChatGPT Images 2.0 to generate a 3x3 storyboard grid, then feed that grid into Claude to refine scene descriptions and prompts  
Have Claude convert each storyboard panel into a detailed Seedance 2.0 video prompt that explicitly includes camera angle, lighting, motion, and mood  
Copy each per-scene prompt from Claude directly into Seedance 2.0 (or Kling) to generate the video clips  
Ask Claude to rewrite the script for spoken delivery with pauses, emphasis, and pacing notes, then paste into ElevenLabs to generate the voiceover  
Ask Claude for 5 thumbnail concepts per video, generate the best in ChatGPT Images 2.0, and test 3 thumbnail variations per upload  
Ask Claude to generate platform-specific titles, descriptions, tags, and hashtags for YouTube, TikTok, and Reels, and save the format as a reusable template  
Repurpose by pasting the long-form script into Claude and asking it to cut 3–5 short-form hooks, with each hook becoming a separate Short or Reel  
Save reusable templates for your script, storyboard prompt, and video prompt so you can repeat the pipeline quickly
